html:
SMTO-UI-0014 — Your message can't be sent yet

GUID: b7370775-64fe-406d-9e10-8dde5d1fcc58
Slug: ui-composer-not-ready
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • SMTO didn't send your message because this conversation's settings or the computer it should run on aren't ready yet. Nothing was started.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait a few seconds if the note under the message box says Loading conversation settings or Saving conversation policy, then send again. SMTO won't send while it's still loading or saving this conversation's settings.
  2. If you see a Retry settings button under the message box, select it and wait for the note to clear. The conversation's settings didn't load or save, and SMTO needs them before it can start a task.
  3. Open the Gateway picker in the message box. Choose at least one enabled Gateway, the helper program that runs tasks on a computer, or select Refresh targets. SMTO needs a working, enabled Gateway it has just checked before it can run your request.
  4. If nothing changes, refresh the browser page and open the conversation again. Refreshing reloads the conversation's settings and the list of Gateways from scratch.

What success looks like

  • The note under the message box clears and your message is sent.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. If no Gateway appears, ask them to check Settings › Setup › Gateways.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Submission was blocked because the composer profile is loading or failed to load, a policy save is pending or failed, the Gateway selection is missing or invalid, or execution targets could not be verified.

What this means

  • Submission finds the composer loading, missing profile/model/target, a pending or failed policy update, or an unavailable target selection. This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.

Why this can happen

  • Submission finds the composer loading, missing profile/model/target, a pending or failed policy update, or an unavailable target selection.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the concrete composer readiness condition and selected target availability.

How to fix it

  • composerProblem() (app.js), submission() (conversation_composer_profile.js) and target unavailable() (target_selector.js, mobile/target_state.js) block send while the profile is loading, policyPending/policyError is set, gateway_id is missing, or targets are unloaded, failed, missing or disabled. Read the composer status text, retry the profile load or Refresh targets, select an enabled Gateway, then resubmit.
  • Load this conversation’s saved settings, select an available target and model, and resolve the displayed conflict before sending.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended profile, model, target and policy finish loading coherently before send.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
